risks.body:
- MD&A 'Risk & Concern' names market risk (including liquidity risk) as one of the risks the Company is mainly exposed to; liquidity risk is the risk of difficulty meeting obligations settled by delivering cash or another financial asset.
- The Company is exposed to interest rate risk through the impact of rate changes on interest-bearing liabilities and assets.
- Credit risk arises principally from the Company's trade and other receivables, cash and cash equivalents and other bank balances, i.e. counterparty default risk.
- MD&A 'Risk & Concern' section states the Company has put in place mitigation measures covering business portfolio risk, financial risk, legal risk and internal process risk.
- Directors' Report states the Risk Management and Internal Control framework is commensurate with the Company's size, but the Company is trying to strengthen the same, implying it is not yet fully mature.
- The Company has been impleaded in certain legal cases related to disputes over title to shares arising in the ordinary course of share transfer operations, though none are considered material.
- MD&A cites global policy uncertainty from trade-relationship reordering, financial market repricing, evolving fiscal priorities, supply fragilities, inflation volatility and fragmented central-bank policy signals as an external backdrop risk.
